name: ole_text
expr: [[s.ShapeType.split('.')[-1], s.String, s.CLSID] for s in [doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0).getByIndex(i) for i in range(doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0).Count)]]

name: ole_paragraphs
expr: [[(lambda en: [p.String for p in [en.nextElement() for _ in iter(en.hasMoreElements, False)]])(s.createEnumeration())] for s in [doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0).getByIndex(i) for i in range(doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0).Count)]]

name: ole_has_field
expr: [any(pt.TextPortionType == 'TextField' for pt in (lambda en: [en.nextElement() for _ in iter(en.hasMoreElements, False)])(par.createEnumeration())) for s in [doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0).getByIndex(i) for i in range(doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0).Count)] for par in (lambda en: [en.nextElement() for _ in iter(en.hasMoreElements, False)])(s.createEnumeration())]
